parts.zh: W: 我一直在想，今年夏天
M: 露营车？你的意思是整个夏天都住在车里？
M: 我觉得我爷爷以前就有一辆那样的车
W: 现在的露营车完全不一样了
M: 我开始有点接受这个想法了
W: 现在有很多人全职投入这种生活方式
M: 好吧，我们可以考虑一下
W: 别急。很高兴你这么兴奋
M: 听着，你在我们这儿工作快五年了

items.stem: What has the woman been thinking of doing for this summer?

choices.text: Renting a car instead of driving their own.
choices.zh: 租一辆车而不是开他们自己的车。

choices.text: Surfing online to check out the best deals.
choices.zh: 在网上浏览以查看最优惠的价格。

choices.text: Exploring more summer holiday resorts.
choices.zh: 探索更多的避暑度假胜地。

choices.text: Spending their holidays in a novel way.
choices.zh: 以一种新颖的方式度过假期。

items.stem: What do we learn about the man's grandfather from the conversation?

choices.text: He once owned a van.
choices.zh: 他曾经拥有一辆面包车。

choices.text: He was well travelled.
choices.zh: 他去过很多地方旅行。

choices.text: He did not find holiday homes appealing.
choices.zh: 他觉得度假屋没有吸引力。

choices.text: He did not like to be locked into one place.
choices.zh: 他不喜欢被限制在一个地方。

items.stem: What can many camper vans do nowadays according to the woman?

choices.text: Ensure the safety of passengers.
choices.zh: 确保乘客的安全。

choices.text: Drive under any weather condition.
choices.zh: 在任何天气条件下行驶。

choices.text: Receive instructions via computers.
choices.zh: 通过计算机接收指令。

choices.text: Generate their own electricity.
choices.zh: 自行发电。

items.stem: What idea does the woman find attractive?

choices.text: Having one's basic needs covered while away from home.
choices.zh: 离家在外时基本需求得到满足。

choices.text: Enjoying the freedom to choose where to go and work.
choices.zh: 享有选择去哪里和在哪里工作的自由。

choices.text: Slowing down in one's increasingly hectic life.
choices.zh: 在日益忙碌的生活中放慢节奏。

choices.text: Riding one's mountain bike on vacation.
choices.zh: 度假时骑山地自行车。

items.stem: What do we learn about the woman from the man's description?

choices.text: She has missed several important appointments lately.
choices.zh: 她最近错过了几个重要的约会。

choices.text: Her job performance has worsened over the past month.
choices.zh: 她过去一个月的工作表现变差了。

choices.text: She has lagged behind most of her co-workers in output.
choices.zh: 她的产出落后于大多数同事。

choices.text: Her physical health has deteriorated these past few weeks.
choices.zh: 她过去几周的身体健康状况恶化了。

items.stem: What does the woman say she's experiencing at the moment?

choices.text: Serious health issues.
choices.zh: 严重的健康问题。

choices.text: Disturbance of her mind.
choices.zh: 精神上的困扰。

choices.text: Some problems at home.
choices.zh: 家里的一些问题。

choices.text: Penalty for curtailed output.
choices.zh: 因产出减少而受到的处罚。

items.stem: What does the man say makes his job far easier?

choices.text: The woman's work proficiency.
choices.zh: 女士的工作能力。

choices.text: The woman's whole-hearted support.
choices.zh: 女士的全心全意支持。

choices.text: His engaging personality.
choices.zh: 他有吸引力的个性。

choices.text: His management capability.
choices.zh: 他的管理能力。

items.stem: What agreement have the speakers reached by the end of the conversation?

choices.text: The woman will resume her work in two weeks.
choices.zh: 女士将在两周后恢复工作。

choices.text: The man will be back at his 100% in a couple of weeks.
choices.zh: 男士将在几周内恢复到百分之百的状态。

choices.text: The woman will be off work on the next two Mondays.
choices.zh: 女士接下来两个星期一将休假。

choices.text: The man will help the woman get back to her usual self.
choices.zh: 男士将帮助女士恢复到她平常的状态。

items.stem: What does research suggest about a higher level of education?

choices.text: It can have an impact on our moods and emotions.
choices.zh: 它可以影响我们的心境和情绪。

choices.text: It can enable us to live a healthier and longer life.
choices.zh: 它可以使我们过上更健康、更长寿的生活。

choices.text: It can improve our financial status significantly.
choices.zh: 它可以显著改善我们的经济状况。

choices.text: It can help us achieve better work performance.
choices.zh: 它可以帮助我们取得更好的工作表现。

items.stem: What do we learn from the finding of the new research?

choices.text: One's health tends to differ before and after marriage.
choices.zh: 一个人的健康状况在婚前和婚后往往有所不同。

choices.text: One's health status is related to one's social background.
choices.zh: 一个人的健康状况与其社会背景有关。

choices.text: The wealthier one's spouse is, the healthier one becomes.
choices.zh: 配偶越富有,一个人就越健康。

choices.text: The spouse's level of education can impact one's health.
choices.zh: 配偶的教育水平可以影响一个人的健康。

items.stem: What does the passage say about the men in the sample of the new research?

choices.text: They benefited a lot from their career achievements.
choices.zh: 他们从自己的职业成就中受益匪浅。

choices.text: They showed interest in their spouse's occupations.
choices.zh: 他们对配偶的职业表现出兴趣。

choices.text: They had much in common with their spouses.
choices.zh: 他们与配偶有很多共同点。

choices.text: They had more education than their spouses.
choices.zh: 他们比配偶受过更多教育。

items.stem: What is said to be a key challenge for cities prone to floods?

choices.text: Eliminating their root cause.
choices.zh: 消除洪水的根本原因。

choices.text: Forecasting flood risks accurately.
choices.zh: 准确预测洪水风险。

choices.text: Identifying the cities' geological features.
choices.zh: 识别城市的地质特征。

choices.text: Finding out the changing climate patterns.
choices.zh: 找出不断变化的气候模式。

items.stem: For what purpose does Derek Loftis collect the data of ordinary citizens during high tides?

choices.text: To validate his hypothesis about the gravity of floods.
choices.zh: 验证他关于洪水严重程度的假设。

choices.text: To determine the frequency of high tides causing floods.
choices.zh: 确定引发洪水的大潮发生频率。

choices.text: To improve his mathematical flooding model.
choices.zh: 改进他的洪水数学模型。

choices.text: To see the feasibility of his project on flooding.
choices.zh: 了解他的洪水项目的可行性。

items.stem: What does the passage say is Derek Loftis's mission?

choices.text: To study the consequences of high tides on flooded areas.
choices.zh: 研究大潮对洪水淹没地区的后果。

choices.text: To teach local citizens how to collect data of incoming floods.
choices.zh: 教当地市民如何收集即将到来的洪水的数据。

choices.text: To forecast rapid floods in real time.
choices.zh: 实时预报快速洪水。

choices.text: To classify the flooding data processed.
choices.zh: 对处理过的洪水数据进行分类。

items.stem: What did Loftis and his colleagues do to obtain data about water height and movement?

choices.text: They set up Internet-connected water-level sensors.
choices.zh: 他们安装了联网的水位传感器。

choices.text: They tracked the rising tides with video-cameras.
choices.zh: 他们用摄像机追踪涨潮情况。

choices.text: They used newly-developed supercomputing facilities.
choices.zh: 他们使用了新开发的超级计算设施。

choices.text: They observed the direction of water flow on the spot.
choices.zh: 他们现场观察水流方向。

items.stem: What does the speaker say has become something of a ritual?

choices.text: To argue about the value of a college degree.
choices.zh: 争论大学学位的价值。

choices.text: To debate the validity of current survey data.
choices.zh: 辩论当前调查数据的有效性。

choices.text: To account for the drastic decline in employment among men.
choices.zh: 解释男性就业急剧下降的原因。

choices.text: To compare men without college degrees with those who have.
choices.zh: 将没有大学学位的男性与有大学学位的男性进行比较。

items.stem: What did the researchers of a recent working paper consider first?

choices.text: The increase in women taking up jobs.
choices.zh: 女性从事工作的增加。

choices.text: The issue of changing job requirements.
choices.zh: 工作要求变化的问题。

choices.text: The factor of wages.
choices.zh: 工资因素。

choices.text: The impact of inflation.
choices.zh: 通货膨胀的影响。

items.stem: What did the recent paper identify as a new potential explanation of the problem concerning men's employment?

choices.text: Men's unwillingness to accept low wages in times of growing inflation.
choices.zh: 男性在通货膨胀加剧时期不愿接受低工资。

choices.text: The wage gap between those with college degrees and those without.
choices.zh: 有大学学位者与无大学学位者之间的工资差距。

choices.text: More jobs requiring their holders to have a college degree nowadays.
choices.zh: 如今更多工作要求持有者拥有大学学位。

choices.text: The sharp decline in marriage among men with no college degrees.
choices.zh: 没有大学学位的男性结婚率急剧下降。

items.stem: What has a market research team found in its latest fashion and sustainability report?

choices.text: More and more people attach importance to protecting endangered animals.
choices.zh: 越来越多的人重视保护濒危动物。

choices.text: More and more people prioritize animal welfare when buying things to wear.
choices.zh: 越来越多的人在购买穿戴物品时优先考虑动物福利。

choices.text: An increasing number of people demand to free animals being kept in cages.
choices.zh: 越来越多的人要求释放被关在笼子里的动物。

choices.text: An increasing number of people follow the latest trend of becoming vegetarians.
choices.zh: 越来越多的人追随成为素食主义者的最新潮流。

items.stem: What have some world-renowned fashion designers done for some time?

choices.text: Avoided the use of leather and fur.
choices.zh: 避免使用皮革和毛皮。

choices.text: Labelled all their products as vegan.
choices.zh: 将他们所有的产品标注为纯素产品。

choices.text: Refrained from using chemicals in their products.
choices.zh: 避免在产品中使用化学物质。

choices.text: Utilized a silk substitute made from mushrooms.
choices.zh: 使用由蘑菇制成的丝绸替代品。

items.stem: What does the speaker say is unclear concerning vegan products?

choices.text: Whether they actually signify a substantial change.
choices.zh: 它们是否真正标志着实质性的改变。

choices.text: Whether they effectively protect animals at large.
choices.zh: 它们是否能有效地保护整体上的动物。

choices.text: Whether they can be considered sustainable.
choices.zh: 它们是否可以被认为是可持续的。

choices.text: Whether they can be regarded as ethical.
choices.zh: 它们是否可以被视为符合伦理的。

items.stem: What is one of the facts stated by the speaker?

choices.text: The era we live in is the most peaceful in history.
choices.zh: 我们生活的时代是历史上最和平的。

choices.text: The world has seen more violence in recent years.
choices.zh: 近年来世界上发生了更多暴力事件。

choices.text: The environmental welfare has worsened in the world.
choices.zh: 世界环境福祉已经恶化。

choices.text: The belief is less prevalent that the world is going to hell.
choices.zh: 认为世界正在走向毁灭的观念不那么普遍了。

items.stem: What do we learn about most British and French people in a 2015 survey for YouGov?

choices.text: They were actually not in their right mind.
choices.zh: 他们实际上神智不清。

choices.text: They believed the world was deteriorating.
choices.zh: 他们认为世界正在恶化。

choices.text: They did not wish to live in the previous century.
choices.zh: 他们不愿生活在上个世纪。

choices.text: They were convinced by the statistics presented to them.
choices.zh: 他们被呈现给他们的统计数据说服了。

items.stem: What does our prevailing mood of despair indicate?

choices.text: The subjectivity of mass media.
choices.zh: 大众媒体的主观性。

choices.text: The current state of affairs.
choices.zh: 当前的事态。

choices.text: Our psychological biases.
choices.zh: 我们的心理偏见。

choices.text: Our ancestors' influence.
choices.zh: 我们祖先的影响。

items.stem: What was a very good thing in our evolutionary past?

choices.text: Spreading exciting news around us far and wide.
choices.zh: 把令人兴奋的消息广泛传播到我们周围。

choices.text: Vacuuming up depressing or enraging stories.
choices.zh: 大量吸收令人沮丧或愤怒的故事。

choices.text: Calculating dangerous risks to our survival.
choices.zh: 计算对我们生存的危险风险。

choices.text: Paying attention to negative information.
choices.zh: 关注负面信息。
